title: Inventory Tracker (crud-heavy)
prompt:
# PRD — Inventory Tracker (crud-heavy)
PRD Standard: 1
Interface language: en-US

## 1. Problem and objective / Problema e objetivo

A signed-in team member needs to maintain stock quantities, retain adjustment history, and find low-stock items quickly.

## 2. Users and roles / Usuários e papéis

- Team member: manages the team's categories, items, adjustments, and item images.

## 3. Scope and non-goals / Escopo e não objetivos

Categories, items, single and bulk quantity adjustments, adjustment history, low-stock filtering, and one optional item image are in scope. Multi-warehouse tracking, barcode scanning, suppliers, purchase orders, CSV import or export, and reporting or analytics are excluded.

## 4. Primary journeys / Jornadas principais

1. A member signs in, creates a category and item, adjusts quantity with a reason, and finds the item through the low-stock filter.
2. A member selects multiple items and applies one reasoned quantity adjustment to each.
3. A member uploads, replaces, and views an optional item image.

## 5. Screens and states / Telas e estados

The protected inventory shell contains category, item list, item form, bulk adjustment, and item history screens with loading, empty, error, forbidden, and success states. The item form accepts one PNG or JPEG image up to 2 MB and shows a placeholder when absent.

## 6. Functional requirements / Requisitos funcionais

- **FR-001**: A member can create, edit, and delete categories, except a category containing items cannot be deleted.
- **FR-002**: A member can create, edit, delete, filter, and inspect items.
- **FR-003**: Single and bulk quantity changes require a reason and append one history entry per item.
- **FR-004**: A member can upload or replace one optional PNG or JPEG item image up to 2 MB, and replacing it removes the previous object.

## 7. Conceptual data and ownership / Dados conceituais e propriedade

Categories group items; each item has a unique SKU, quantity, reorder threshold, and optional image; each adjustment belongs to one item and records delta, reason, actor, and time. Inventory records and private image objects are available only to signed-in team members.

## 8. Business rules / Regras de negócio

- **BR-001**: Item quantity and reorder threshold are non-negative integers.
- **BR-002**: An item is low stock when quantity is less than or equal to its reorder threshold.

## 9. Authentication and permissions / Autenticação e permissões

All inventory routes require email/password authentication. Signed-out access redirects to sign-in, and only signed-in users can read item images.

## 10. Non-functional requirements / Requisitos não funcionais

- **NFR-001**: Forms and bulk actions are keyboard accessible and expose inline validation errors.

## 11. Acceptance criteria / Critérios de aceite

- **AC-001** — Verifies: FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, BR-001, BR-002, NFR-001
  - Given a signed-in member with two items
  - When the member applies a reasoned bulk decrement, uploads an image to one item, and reloads
  - Then both low-stock items and their adjustment rows appear, and the uploaded image remains visible.

## 12. Assumptions / Premissas

None

## 13. Open decisions / Decisões em aberto

None
expectedCapabilities: A signed-in user can create a category, create an item in it, adjust its quantity down below threshold, and see it appear in the low-stock filter.
Bulk-editing 2+ items writes one adjustment row per item with the same reason.
Uploading an image to an item stores the object and shows it on the item view after a reload.
Signed-out access to any app route redirects to sign-in.
